stem: A canopy work order specifies removing damaged lower growth but a plant shows an unusual stem lesion near the planned cut area. What should the technician do?
choices: Pause work on that plant, document the lesion, and follow the escalation procedure before cutting through the affected area
Remove the entire plant without authorization
Ignore the lesion because the work order mentions lower growth
rationale: Unexpected plant conditions can change the risk of a routine task. The technician should document and escalate rather than blindly complete the cut.
